name: Enterprise Commercial Landscape and Market Scope
constraints: Commercial Landscape is a governed read-only profile and Market Scope is its versioned parameter set.
Released output is an immutable digest-identified projection and neither construct creates a business-object identity.
Party identity is reused across customer, supplier and partner roles while role-specific facts remain separate.
Customer and supplier monetary facts are never netted solely because they share a party anchor.
Market Scope declares seller entities, channels, intercompany rule, segmentation scheme and version, period, time horizons, scenario and disclosure grain.
Grouping cites a governed ownership, control or consolidation boundary rather than CRM hierarchy.
Unknown-parent relationships remain reason-coded singleton buckets.
Disputed group links preserve competing claims, claimant capacities and attributed result ranges.
Each order line, subscription charge or observed delivery has one fact key and one attribution path.
Rollups use set union of facts rather than sums of pre-aggregated subtotals.
Forecast, pipeline, quote, order, subscription, delivery and recognized revenue remain parallel measures with separate authorities.
Forecast coverage distinguishes backed, partial, unbacked-open, unbacked-lapsed and unevaluable outcomes.
World time, knowledge time, measurement phenomenon time, result time and ingestion time remain distinct.
Group membership never grants access; cross-controller data requires WM-XCT-002 authorization and WM-XCT-003 disclosure shape.
Released views pin input revisions, preserve attribution buckets and cannot be re-imported as source truth.
holds: WM-ORG-014 and WM-ECO-020 remain non-canonical drafts with provider, relationship and entry-kind gaps.
WM-ORG-012 retains its parent/reference conflict and WM-MAT-008 has an open cardinality hold.
The supplier-role master WM-ORG-015 was not frozen in the source checkpoint.
Segmentation and concentration crosswalks, methods and fixtures remain unverified.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit remain pending.
